recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Future wording changes should be made in UTG/THO and verified through the FHIR ValueSet expansion.
issue_request: FHIR-36305 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Observation and asked to clarify the Observation.category code survey by defining it as observations from survey instruments, questionnaires, forms, and assessment tools.
initial_application: No core source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-36305 was found. Current FHIR core keeps Observation active and binds Observation.category to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/observation-category, but that ValueSet only composes the external THO CodeSystem http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category. The old core CodeSystem source with the previous survey definition was deleted by 5c0494aacf when UTG content was removed from the core build.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread proposed the same wording; OO minutes added the Jira to block vote; later Jira comments directed implementation through UTG and identified the THO CodeSystem/ValueSet plus build.fhir.org ValueSet as the affected surfaces. UP-738 is Proposal Implemented and changed the UTG source-of-truth CodeSystem for R6 ballot Observation Category Codes.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core source file was changed because the editable survey concept definition is maintained in THO/UTG, while the active core ValueSet source correctly includes that external CodeSystem.
